notes.title: 0.4.0b 'Solace' [2023.09.16]
notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Diplomacy Panel[/b] -> Species Icon -> Tooltip -> Gives info about climate preference and origin type.
[/list]
[h2]Improved[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Alliances[/b] -> Share system intel with allies when exploring new systems.
[*] [b]Trails[/b] -> Use new trail VFX for crimson and non-crimson ships.
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Achievements[/b] -> Icons now use improved human-created artwork.
[*] [b]Load Save[/b] -> Added warning if save version is out of date.
[*] [b]Origins[/b] -> Special planet origins now spawn with their special resource.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix: [b]Load Save[/b] -> Some saves were not loading correctly due to version compatibility issues.
    -> Should also work retroactively with saves from mid-August.
    -> May enforce version-locking for saves in the future to mitigate save/load problems.
[*] Fix: [b]Allies[/b] -> Share visibility continues to share visibility, as originally intended.
[*] Fix: [b]Built[/b] -> [b]Research Panel[/b] -> Sometimes becomes temporarily unresponsive.
[*] Fix: [b]Business[/b] -> Can continue queuing buildings past the slot limit (could not reproduce in tests).
[*] Fix: [b]Colony[/b] -> Business owner not refunded when order cancelled in a foreign colony.
[*] Fix: [b]Defeat Screen[/b] -> Does not open when a colony is lost.
[*] Fix: [b]Diplomacy Panel[/b] -> Leave alliance tooltip shows HTML color text.
[*] Fix: [b]Diplomacy Panel[/b] -> Opinion tooltip -> Text wrapping not working.
[*] Fix: [b]Fleet Detection[/b] -> Foreign fleet in visible system should be met instantly.
[*] Fix: [b]Load Save[/b] -> Does not update the galaxy map.
[*] Fix: [b]Load Save[/b] -> Save reloads map improperly.
[*] Fix: [b]Player Claims[/b] -> Does not immediately update resolution when changing graphics quality.
[*] Fix: [b]Tips Panel[/b] -> Species avatar is not applied correctly, causing tips to not work properly.
[*] Fix: [b]Ubiquity[/b] -> Moving camera too fast moves limitless stars.
[*] Fix: [b]Cross-Scene[/b] -> Start game -> After loading save, loads save instead of scene.
[/list]
[h2]Tweaked[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tweak: [b]Colonists[/b] -> Now takes 1 year and small fleets take 60 days to build, on standard speed.
[*] Tweak: [b]Colonists[/b] -> Now costs 200/200 metals/food on standard speed.
[/list]
[h2]Deprecated[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ship Builder[/b] -> Future ship builder bug fixes won't be supported.
    -> Scope-creep; May remove in the near future and could replace with a simpler system over time.
    -> Assets are ancient and contain almost more lines of code than the rest of the project.
    -> There are many bugs with the current ship builder.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3.0b 'Solace' [2023.09.13]
notes.content:
Made diplomacy panel easier to understand and improved research panel visuals. There are also bug fixes and other improvements. However, issues remain with loading saves.

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Diplomacy Panel[/b] -> Agendas UI -> Added different icon for each agenda, with info.
[*] [b]Diplomacy Panel[/b] -> New detailed tooltips for every diplomatic action.
[/list]
[h2]Improved[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ubiquity[/b] -> Ships now slow down to rotate towards a target, resulting in much more natural movement.
[*] [b]Ability Icons[/b] -> Now uses new artwork icons, instead of previous flat icons.
[*] [b]Research Panel[/b] -> Now uses new artwork icons, instead of previous flat icons.
[*] [b]Diplomacy Panel[/b] -> Only counts systems with known intel.
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tech[/b] -> Repeatable Starbase Defence -> Changed from [b]+10%[/b] to [b]+15%[/b].
[*] [b]AI Players[/b] -> AI is now much less likely to spawn in as a non-default origin.
[*] [b]Colony[/b] -> Intel is based on parent system, not intel of colony owner.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix: [b]Diplomacy Panel[/b] -> SFX goes crazy after a month has passed.
[*] Fix: [b]Playmode UI[/b] -> Does not display peacekeeping pacifist details correctly.
[*] Fix: [b]Trade Panel[/b] -> Does not work correctly (caused by issues with internal serializer).
[*] Fix: [b]Battle[/b] -> Starts battle when not inside combat radius.
[*] Fix: [b]Ubiquity[/b] -> Ships don't explode when destroyed.
[*] Fix: [b]Combat[/b] -> [i]Engagement Range[/i] -> Does not work.
[*] Fix: [b]AI[/b] -> Does not designate bases.
[/list]

[i]Note: Issues with loading saves may persist, and build version shows incorrect date.[/i]

notes.title: 0.2.0b 'Solace' [2023.09.08]
notes.content:
[h2]Improved[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Pings[/b] -> Upgraded most ping SFX to use new sci-fi sounds.
[*] [b]Species Avatars[/b] -> Replaced AI-generated placeholders with human and alien icons.
[*] [b]Diplomacy Panel[/b] -> Has new sci-fi holographic SFX, instead of a repetitive typewriter sound.
[*] [b]Colony Siege[/b] -> When colony is occupied, some buildings are demolished.
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ubiquity[/b] -> Asteroid fields no longer spawns in systems with multiple stars.
[/list]

[h2]Tweaked[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Game Events[/b] -> 'Asteroid Appears' may happen every [b]25[/b] in-game years instead of [b]50[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix: [b]Ubiquity Inspector[/b] -> New black holes don't appear correctly.
[*] Fix: [b]Ubiquity[/b] -> [i]Cinematic Mode Lens[/i] -> Does not hide starbase labels.
[*] Fix: [b]Ping[/b] -> Does not have click/hover SFX.
[*] Fix: [b]Fleet[/b] -> Merge and Split -> Duplicates fleets with large numbers (12 gunboats became 14).
[*] Fix: [b]Main Menu[/b] -> Steam details not displaying.
[*] Fix: [b]Fleet[/b] -> Splitting fleet with five ships creates a sixth ship.
[*] Fix: [b]Fleet[/b] -> Merge and Split -> Copies the same name over and over.
[*] Fix: [b]Built[/b] -> Interaction Manager -> Sometimes visualized hyperlanes remain.
[*] Fix: [b]Ubiquity[/b] -> Ship branding not working for crimson ships.
[*] Fix: [b]Load Save[/b] -> Does not work and requires game reload.
[*] Fix: [b]Starbase Order Manager[/b] -> Designate Dock completed instantly.
[*] Fix: [b]Starbase Designation[/b] -> Takes no time.
[/list]

[h2]Removed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Remove: [b]Old Avatars[/b] -> Replaced with human created avatars.
    - Note: Previous saves will have empty avatars.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.1b 'Celestial' [2023.09.03]
notes.content:
[h2]Improved[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improve: [b]Main Menu[/b] -> [i]Difficulty Selector[/i] -> Now uses more universal difficulty labels.
[*] Improve: [b]Time Manager[/b] -> Added more time scale combinations.
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Change: [b]Diplomacy[/b] -> Now requires allied relations, not just friendly, to have full intel.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix: [b]Game[/b] -> Does not work in Steam offline mode / without connection.
[*] Fix: [b]Save Game[/b] -> Throws error when saving star system.
[*] Fix: [b]Endgame Screen[/b] -> Leaderboard does not appear.
[*] Fix: [b]Start Menu[/b] -> Username is not cropped.
[*] Fix: [b]Loading Screen[/b] -> Playmode UI shows wrong playmode when loading save.
[*] Fix: [b]Tips Panel UI[/b] -> Font appears too small and blurred.
[*] Fix: [b]Diplomacy Panel[/b] -> Relations Grid -> Relationship icons are too hard to understand.
[*] Fix: [b]Lens buttons[/b] -> Appears too small.
[*] Fix: [b]Pings[/b] -> Appears too small.
[*] Fix: [b]Time Text[/b] -> System time does not update when paused.
[*] Fix: [b]Cobalt[/b] -> Settings -> Anti-aliasing selector does not work.
[/list]

[i]Note: In-game version appears as '0.1.0b' for this update.[/i]

https://newstarsgame.com/changelog

notes.title: 0.1.0b 'Celestial' [2023.09.02]
notes.content:
[h2]Add[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ubiquity -> Black holes are now animated and has new VFX.
[/list]

[h2]Improved[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ubiquity -> Environment nebula now has a contiguous skybox.
[/list]

[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] UI -> Backgrounds are less explicit.
[*] UI -> Borders are now more thin.
[*] Saving -> Player preset is now saved with the game.
[/list]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix: Camera -> Looking up too fast snaps camera down.
[*] Fix: Create Game -> Causes 'memory freeze' (caused by custom system generation issues).
[*] Fix: Ubiquity -> Stars sometimes spawn inside each other.
[*] Fix: Player Claims -> Does not immediately update resolution when change graphics quality.
[*] Fix: Lens Buttons -> Views have no tooltips.
[*] Fix: Black Holes -> Highest quality setting appears to have low quality distortion effect.
[*] Fix: Seamless -> Black hole is not evident on map.
[/list]

[h2]Removed[/h2]
[list]
[*] System Presets -> Removed temporarily until all bugs surrounding them are fixed.
[/list]

View the full list of changes: [url=https://newstarsgame.com/changelog]newstarsgame.com/changelog[/url].

notes.title: 0.0.2b 'Celestial' [2023.08.30]
notes.content:
[h2]Improved[/h2]
[list]
[*] Settings -> Default graphics mode is now based on GPU VRAM instead of CPU cores for higher accuracy.
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bug Reporting Menu -> Max reports set to 3.
[*] UI -> Frames have been removed from panel backgrounds.
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix: Bug Reporting -> Can report more than 5 bugs in one session.
[*] Fix: Animated Combat -> Starbase does not shoot at ships.
[/list]

View the full list of changes: [url=https://newstarsgame.com/changelog/]newstarsgame.com/changelog[/url].
